scope: Type or choose within province, regency/city and district filters; preserve the minimal design and URL-driven selection.
automated: 14 Node tests, ESLint and TypeScript/Vite production build passed. The existing MapLibre chunk-size warning remains.
browserChecks: Typed mixed-case, space-padded bALi; Enter selected province 51 and kept input focus.
Typed denpas and selected Kota Denpasar; Tab moved to the enabled district input. Typed selatan and selected Denpasar Selatan (517101).
An unmatched province query displayed Wilayah tidak ditemukan with no options. Enter did not change the URL; Escape restored Bali and closed the popup.
Clicked Jawa Tengah from the dropdown in a 390x844 mobile/touch viewport. The URL became province=33 and the previous city/district selections cleared.

After a keyboard check exposed hover interference, changed hover tracking to mouse movement. Rechecked: opening Jawa Timur retained it as the active option, ArrowDown highlighted Banten, and Enter selected province 36.
Back navigation restored the previous province name. Reset cleared the URL and disabled city/district filters.
Typed papua on mobile: six matching province options, popup within viewport, no horizontal overflow, 16px input font. Tab discarded unselected search text and closed the popup.
At 1440x900 all three inputs have 44px height and no horizontal overflow. Screenshots: searchable-desktop.jpg and searchable-mobile.jpg.
limits: Checked Chromium with emulated mobile/touch; physical devices, screen readers, Safari and Firefox were not tested.
